selection.method: secrets.choice (operating-system randomness), uniform over top three

shortlist.reason: Four SQL queries per plugin on every catalogue request; simple repository/service batching, low regression risk.
One serialized guest exec per untracked file on a common Git read; high transport sensitivity, moderate concurrency/resource risk.
Repeated transactions, aggregates, inserts and refreshes for each copied message/part; high latency but less frequent and greater atomicity/ordering risk.

method: Two sequential batches per version, reverse version order in batch 2; five warmups then 51 samples per endpoint/case/batch. No concurrent test suite. SQL capture and allocation tracing are separate probes.

baseline.benchmark: isolated file-backed SQLite plugin catalogue REST
notes: Authenticated Django HTTP test client, including JSON serialization.
Mixed global/org, disabled/unpublished, activated and foreign fixtures.
No live credentials, provider calls, runner or external services.
SQL capture and Python allocation tracing are separate from timings.
SQL timing has millisecond resolution; allocation peaks are not RSS.
Warm local timings are not production database/network SLOs.
